description: Cross-border payment with multiple intermediary banks
test_coverage: Field 53A (Sender's Correspondent) - Bank of America NY
Field 57A (Account With Institution) - Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation
Field 59 with Japanese domestic account number (no IBAN)
Multi-hop routing: UK -> US -> HK -> JP
SHA charge bearer for cross-border payment
business_rules_expected_to_pass: JPY currency code valid (zero decimal places)
notes: Demonstrates complex cross-border payment routing from UK to Japan. Uses correspondent banking relationships: HSBC London sends through HSBC's network via Bank of America (US correspondent), then HSBC Hong Kong (regional hub), finally to beneficiary's bank Sumitomo Mitsui in Tokyo. JPY currency uses zero decimal places (5000000, not 5000000,00). British ordering customer has IBAN, Japanese beneficiary uses domestic account number. Typical for international trade payments where direct banking relationships don't exist between sender and receiver banks.
